chapter: Chicago clubs, entertainers and tent shows
title: Entertainers Florence Mills and Cora Green
summary: He knew of Florence Mills and Cora Green at the Deluxe but had no contact with them.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And, now, I'm going to mention some entertainers who were at the Deluxe.
And, let me just fix your microphone here. Now some entertainers at the Deluxe. Do you -- Florence Mills, of course.
Yes, but do you remember Florence Mills being at the Deluxe?
Yes, I heard of her being at the Deluxe, although I didn't, you know, it was just another performer, I didn't -- she didn't become real famous, I don't think till she came to New York with the show.
'Shuffle Along, yes. I knew of her, yes.
Now there were some girls who worked with her. Cora Green.
Can you tell me anything about these people, that I mentioned?

Well, you know, as I said before, they were very famous, I mean popular in Chicago and that was the time -- I had just arrived in Chicago at that time and so I didn't come in contact with them personally, but as a musician working in the clubs there, I did know of them.
Cora Green and Florence Mills, by name, but I didn't come in contact with any of them, at all.
